editorNote: Google DeepMind introduced Genie 4, its interactive world-simulation model, and four outlets covered it; the lab post is the one to read. The other thread is OpenAI’s GPT-6.1 Terra, alongside the Anthropic IPO filing and the governance and risk questions it raises. Beyond that it was a quiet day: mostly narrow preprints and vendor engineering posts.
